Max HR is estimated as 220 − age, a rough average. Zones are guidance, not medical precision.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your age.
  2. Enter your resting heart rate in BPM (measure it first thing in the morning).
  3. Read your estimated max heart rate.
  4. Use the five zone table to target the right intensity for each workout.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the Karvonen method?

Each zone is a percentage band of your heart-rate reserve (max HR minus resting HR) added back to your resting HR: zone HR = resting + reserve × %. It personalizes zones better than raw % of max HR.

How accurate is 220 minus age?

Max heart rate is estimated as 220 − age. It is a rough population average — individual max can differ by 10–20 bpm, so treat zones as guidance, not precision.

Is it safe to train in zone 5?

Stop, rest, and seek medical advice if you feel dizzy, chest pain or unusual shortness of breath. This tool is for general fitness guidance only.
